remarks: Welcome to this inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bath home in El Nido Estates offering approximately 1,500 square feet of customized living space with enclosed porch for lounging and roomy yard for you beloved pets and entertaining. If you have a dog you will enjoy the convenience of an automated door opener for your dog to go to and from the house to the yard when needed. You’ll love the open, thoughtfully designed floor plan, with the primary suite on one side, the secondary bedrooms on the other, and a spacious great room at the center—creating a natural sense of separation and an easy flow for everyday living.
